en.html: Only a short while later, I was told that she had died.

ja.text: 母が病気だった事は知っていた。
ja.html: 母が病気だった事は知っていた。

en.text: I had known she was ill.
en.html: I had known she was ill.

ja.text: それが治らない病気である事も……。
ja.html: それが治らない病気である事も……。

en.text: I had known the illness could not be cured.
en.html: I had known the illness could not be cured.

ja.text: でも、お母さんから別れて数日で亡くなるなんて思わなかった。
ja.html: でも、お母さんから別れて数日で亡くなるなんて思わなかった。

en.text: But I never imagined she would die only days after we were separated.
en.html: But I never imagined she would die only days after we were separated.

ja.text: だったら、何でお父さんは最後の時を、お母さんと一緒に過ごさせてくれなかったのか……。
ja.html: だったら、何でお父さんは最後の時を、お母さんと一緒に過ごさせてくれなかったのか……。

en.text: If she had so little time, why did Father refuse to let me spend her last moments beside her?
en.html: If she had so little time, why did Father refuse to let me spend her last moments beside her?

ja.text: 私は父を恨んだ。
ja.html: 私は父を恨んだ。

en.text: I resented him.
en.html: I resented him.

ja.text: 実の父親を憎んだ。
ja.html: 実の父親を憎んだ。

en.text: I hated my own father.
en.html: I hated my own father.
